title: Use English source keys for cheat actions and save status
changes: Use English source keys for cheat selector actions and standard-save availability/metadata messages, retaining legacy Italian keys and equivalent Italian catalog translations.
validation: Offline Linux menu and screen test build succeeded with the combined feature selection; the complete menu suite passed 112 tests with one optional test ignored, including both locales and legacy lookup. The first menu-only build lacked wayland-client pkg-config metadata.
limitations: The runtime frontend was not rebuilt and native Windows and real-device presentation were not checked; wider English-first source and documentation audit remains open.
